stem.text: Which statement about the alpha-particle scattering experiment provides evidence for the existence of the nucleus?

A.text: A tiny proportion of the alpha-particles are deflected through large angles.

B.text: Slower alpha-particles are deflected through larger angles.

C.text: The kinetic energies of the deflected alpha-particles are unchanged.

D.text: The number of alpha-particles deflected depends on the thickness of the foil.
